Subject: Premium availability + on-call questions for Pioneer Health

Priyom —

Thanks for the intro earlier. Pioneer Health is evaluating two vendors for inference serving for our clinical decision support pipeline. Before we get legal/ procurement involved, can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the following in a commercial SLA?

- 99.995% monthly uptime for our production namespace (US-EAST primary, auto-failover to US-WEST).
- P1 response: 15 minute acknowledgement, 4 hour mitigation window with an on-call engineer available outside business hours for escalations.
- Root-cause diagnostics and a post-incident report within 72 hours for P1s.
- Contractual credits that scale by severity and affected tokens.

Also: we will likely commit to a 12-month Dedicated capacity block (estimate ~150M tokens/month) if we can get a first-year commercial concession. Please see the attached spreadsheet with our asks and current prioritization.

Send over a rough commercial outline and any constraints (regional failover cost, on-call hourly uplift, required runbook integrations).

Best,
Emily
Emily Fox
Dir., Cloud Platform 
Pioneer Health

Emily —

Appreciate the detail and the spreadsheet. Quick answers up front so your team can plan:

- We can offer a contractual target in the 99.99–99.995% range depending on architecture (true 99.995% requires dedicated cross-region failover and reserve pool).
- We do offer a 15-minute P1 ack option as part of a premium retainer; it typically requires a paid on-call add-on (hourly uplift + monthly retainer) or inclusion in Dedicated retainer hours.
- Post-incident report within 72 hours is standard for P1s on the premium plan.
- Credits: we can structure slab credits tied to minutes of downtime and affected capacity.

I want to loop Rishi for commercial, and Irene + Laura for legal/finance impacts. Matt — thanks for being on the thread; any procurement constraints we should be aware of?

I'll put together two options:
A) Pilot Dedicated block (3-month trial) + premium retainer: lower annual discount, limited failover included.
B) 12-month commitment + cross-region reserve: higher discount, includes on-call coverage and reduced per-token.

Will send a consolidated commercial spreadsheet tomorrow.

—Priyom

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Premium availability + on-call questions for Pioneer Health — need numbers and legal constraints

Priyom / team —

High level legal constraints and recommendations:

- 99.995% with contractual credits: fine, but we must cap aggregate credits per 12-month period (recommendation: max credit cap = 12 months of fees or 30% of ARR, whichever is lower).
- Cross-region failover: accept if customer acknowledges best-effort RTO for application-level consistency; we should exclude third-party cloud provider outages (force majeure carve out).
- On-call escalation: OK to offer guaranteed ack times if backed by retainer + runbook integration. Do not commit unlimited mitigation windows; define SLAs for ack and target mitigation, and tie credits to ack time + sustained degraded minutes.
- Security deliverables: SOC2 Type II summary is fine; pen-test report can be shared under NDA/ASAP but we should avoid broad disclosure of internal findings — share high-level executive summary and remediation timeline.

I will draft the required clause language for credits cap, force majeure, and security disclosure. Laura — please include a margin threshold below which we escalate to Sales Leadership.

Irene

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Fox <emily.fox@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal: Dedicated 12m + premium on-call option (summary)

Emily —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a concise commercial outline and a proposed contract approach (PDF). Highlights below:

Option 1 — 12-month Dedicated commit (recommended):
- Unit rate: $0.0065 / 1k tokens (published rate $0.0085) — 23.5% first-year concession applied to token unit rate.
- Included: cross-region reserve pool for failover (secondary region warm), weekly prefailover drills during first 60 days.
- Premium retainer: $12,000 / month covers P1 15-min ack + guaranteed single-engineer escalation path (up to 30 on-call hours/month). Additional on-call billed at $250/hr.
- Credit scheme: progressive slab — first 10 minutes incident: 0% credit; 10–60 minutes: 5% of monthly committed fees prorated; >60 minutes: 20% of affected capacity fees; aggregate credit cap = 25% of monthly fees; annual cap = 30% of ARR.
- Security: SOC2 Type II report + pen-test executive summary under NDA; KMS integration supported.

Option 2 — 3-month pilot Dedicated block + smaller retainer:
- Unit rate: $0.0075 / 1k tokens (pilot pricing).
- No cross-region reserve included; failover provided with best-effort routing.
- Pilot retainer: $6,000 / month, includes reduced on-call coverage (10 hours/mo).

We can accept either the 20% first-year concession or a one-time $150k onboarding credit (commercially equivalent) — we've priced using the 23.5% concession above to leave room for negotiation.

Next steps: if this looks directionally good, I'll prepare the formal quote and DocuSign link and include the clause language Irene drafted for credits caps and force majeure.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-v1.pdf
